name: Life Bond (Akashic)
body:
You can transfer your own vital essence into another.

Prerequisite(s): Con 17, veilweaver level 5.

Benefit(s): You gain the ability to transfer your life force to other living creatures. As long as you are in physical contact with another creature, you can spend a full round action to transfer any number of your own hit points to that creature. You cannot lower your current hit points below zero with this ability.
